author: Legoche
body:
I wanted to be cool like my meatball
friend jive and that Tazz squeaker kid so I decided to do this 

Lead Apollo here for over a year and been
top 3 every tourney so far.

Used to be a mod here for like a year, I'm currently head mapdev and media.

Currently part of Grim on OCN and have played with them for the last 2 tourneys, last tourney playing as a defender.

I am currently a Badlion arena moderator.

If you want a super nice toxic opinion of you please ask that in the question otherwise I'll be nice!!!
